display_long_description:
# FREE DEMO of RogueGods:
A deck-building roguelite for VR & MR where every card transforms into a weapon you wield, a spell, a power, or even an ally. Build your deck, combine magic rings, and ascend Olympus.

# Features
-  **Build a living deck:**

On each run discover hundreds of cards to add to your build. 
Choose wisely and create unstoppable synergies to crush your enemies.
[media]

-  **Physical, tactical, turn-based combat in XR:**

Summon allies and cast spells and throw weapons with your hands in VR or MR against the hordes of the underworld. Feel the power!
[media]

-  **Magic rings:**

Discover and equip rings with powers that reshape your strategy.
[media]

-  **Infinite replayability:**

A path that never repeats. Procedural maps with shops, mysteries, loot, duels… Every 20–40 min run is different.
[media]

-  **Epic adventure:**

Heroes with unique decks and fighting styles; Olympian gods, mythic characters, and enemies such as centaurs, griffins, and cyclopes.
[media]

# 🚨 RogueGods is in development
Try the demo for Meta Quest and join our Discord to give feedback and follow updates: discord.com/invite/EHMGuTesvK

# The full game will include
-  The full ascent to Olympus with Acts II & III.
-  3 new heroes.
-  300+ cards.
-  100+ rings.
-  50+ unique enemies.
-  And more.

Master Heracles in the Act I demo. Build your deck, gear up, and forge your legend! Do you accept the challenge?
